title: Molecular and spatial profiling identifies immune endotypes for the stratification of OA patients
authors: Gaigeard N; Cardon A; Guiho R; Cubuk C; Ouattara A; Lamothe C; Brouard J; De Lima J; Ahmed M; Le Mercier M; Defois A; Danet L; Perrot J; Benzerdjeb N; Vinatier C; Danger R; Delbos L; Brouard S; Degauque N; Pagliuca S; Lewis M; Fossati-Jimack L; Nerviani A; Waast D; Le Goff B; Blanchard F; Moulin D; Pitzalis C; Guicheux J; Boutet M
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子和空间图谱分析骨关节炎滑膜免疫内型，聚焦疾病分型而非蛋白质-DNA互作，无AI/物理模拟结合建模方法，与本课题无关。
abstract:
ABSTRACT

Osteoarthritis (OA) is a prevalent and heterogeneous joint disease in which synovial inflammation drives structural progression and pain. Despite the recognized heterogeneity of OA, the cellular and molecular organization of synovial tissue remains poorly characterized and defining distinct histological and immune endotypes could guide precision medicine and therapeutic targeting. We show that histologically defined synovial pathotypes are conserved across independent cohorts and correspond to distinct molecular immune endotypes. Integration of bulk and spatial transcriptomics with proteomics revealed niche-specific gene and protein signatures, reflecting the anatomical and functional diversity of OA synovium. The lympho-myeloid pathotype was characterized by mature ectopic lymphoid structures containing CD21 + CD23 + follicular dendritic cells, spatially organized T and B cell zones, and clonally expanded T and B cells with shared immune cell receptor motifs, consistent with local adaptive immune activity correlating with radiological joint damage. These findings highlight how immune organization and cellular composition shape OA pathogenesis and provide a framework for endotype-guided stratification and therapeutic targeting.
abstract_zh:
摘要

骨关节炎（Osteoarthritis, OA）是一种常见且异质性强的关节疾病，其中滑膜炎症驱动结构进展和疼痛。尽管OA的异质性已被公认，但滑膜组织的细胞和分子组织仍缺乏充分表征，定义不同的组织学和免疫内型可能为精准医学和治疗靶向提供指导。我们展示了组织学定义的滑膜病理型在独立队列中保持一致，并对应不同的分子免疫内型。整合批量及空间转录组学与蛋白质组学揭示了位点特异性基因和蛋白质特征，反映了OA滑膜的解剖和功能多样性。淋巴-髓系病理型以含有CD21+ CD23+滤泡树突状细胞的成熟异位淋巴结构为特征，具有空间组织的T和B细胞区域，以及共享免疫细胞受体基序的克隆扩增T和B细胞，这与局部适应性免疫活性相关，且与放射学关节损伤相关。这些发现强调了免疫组织和细胞组成如何塑造OA发病机制，并为内型引导的分层和治疗靶向提供了框架。
